summary: Bit-mask remap helper used by BitFieldMaskMerge: reorders individual bit positions from one mask layout to another. Maps input bit 0 to output value 16, input bit 2 to output 8, input bit 3 to output 4, input bit 4 to output 2, and input bit 5 to output 1; input bit 1 is ignored. Companion to sub_595135 whose mapping is the inverse for the shared bits.

operations.description: If input bit 0 (a1 & 1) is set, assign result = 16 (moves bit 0 to output bit position 4).
If input bit 2 (a1 & 4) is set, set result bit 3 (result |= 8).
If input bit 3 (a1 & 8) is set, set result bit 2 (result |= 4).
If input bit 4 (a1 & 0x10) is set, set result bit 1 (result |= 2).
If input bit 5 (a1 & 0x20) is set, return result with bit 0 set (result | 1).

unresolved: Input bit 1 is never tested; it contributes nothing to the output.
Semantic meaning of the two mask layouts (which field each bit represents) is not recoverable from this function alone.
